finding.claim: Actual N1 meaning UI offered tree; establish as a wrong answer for 創, whose taught meanings include founding or establishing. The establish branch is defensible despite the unrelated tree branch.
finding.impact: A learner can choose a taught meaning and be marked wrong. This is an observed live fallback, not merely a title-search hypothesis.
evidence: Preserved retry753 exactDefaultMeaningOptions and native meaning PNG show the actual 樹 option for 創; two available curated N1 distractors require one fallback because 験 is N4.
Complete frozen JMdict1330410 樹立じゅりつ includes establishment/founding/setting a record; complete1398640 創立そうりつ includes establishment/founding/organization.
Complete1307550 marks 創める as a rare written form but its establishment/start-up sense is not restricted to 始める; general starting and auxiliary senses are restricted.
Full raw 樹 record includes establish/set up; full raw 創 record includes genesis/start/originate. Current complete articles explicitly teach the founding/establishing branch.
Committed actual Digital Daijisen創 sense2 lists 創立 and はじめる. Historical batch015 external evidence is corroboration, not a new independent upstream lookup.
finding.remedy: Append only 樹 to the new 創 card's direct quiz_exclusions. Preserve all ten original pairs, full readings/order, selected keys, curated distractors and the entire legacy 樹 article/metadata.
finding.confidence: High for observed option and source-supported establishment overlap; independent changed-tree acceptance remains pending.
finding.qualification: Not universal interchangeability of 創/樹 or all their compounds. Tree, resin, artistic creation and founding have distinct lexical uses. Pair is direct, symmetric and nontransitive; it adds no exclusions between 樹 and the other ten neighbors.

decisions.reason: A pavilion or restaurant building is not the act of originating/founding it; the establishment-as-building English noun is not an establish verb.
A haiku or actor is not creation/founding. Creating a poem or acting in a creative work does not make these displayed labels synonyms.
Frugality and thrift differ from creation, beginning and wounds. Existing full1255980/1256010 comparison evidence remains.
A colleague/official/companion is a person, not origination or creation.
Ceremony or formal conduct is not founding. A ceremony at a founding is an associated event, not equivalent meaning.
Superfluity/redundancy is not creation or fabrication. The 冗談 joke compound does not make every fabricated story superfluous.
Commonplace/mediocre describes ordinariness, not creating. Originality versus ordinariness is contrast, not synonymous answers.
Convex/protruding is a shape, not beginning, creation or injury. A bump is not by itself a wound.
Sturdy/unyielding strength is a quality, not creation/start or wound.
A sword is not the wound it causes. Existing complete1256750 includes other sword-related senses, not a creation label.
Correct displayed label originate; create; do not reduce the article's other taught founding and wound senses to avoid ambiguity.
Bewitching/supernatural is not creating; a supernatural fictional subject does not make these meanings interchangeable.
The Snake zodiac sign is not creation/start or wound.
Formal two is a numeral, not creation or an initial/first-time meaning.
Handling/dealing with is not bringing into being; handling an injury is not the injury itself. Shared ソウ pronunciation is unrelated to meaning-choice correctness.
Bookmark/guidebook names an object, not its creation.
Observed displayed establish branch and full1330410/1398640 founding overlap justify the new pair; tree/material branches remain distinct.
Wild boar names an animal, not creation, starting or injury.
Raised ridge/land measure is not creating or originating. Cultivating a row does not make the ridge noun a create verb.
A grain-bearing head is not its production; do not import 作る's cultivation sense into the distinct displayed noun.
Silkworm names an insect, not producing or creating; silk production is association only.
Translation/explanation differs from creating an original work; translating something or inventing an explanation does not merge the meanings.
Testing/verification/effect is distinct from creation/start or wound. Remains N4, not incorrectly asserted available in N1.
